name: 3D Gaussian Splatting with Reflection and Relighting
definition: Methods that incorporate classical reflection and shading concepts into the 3DGS framework to address limitations with highly reflective surfaces and enable relighting.
summary: This method extends 3D Gaussian Splatting with physically based rendering to enable dynamic relighting and accurate specular reflections, leveraging Gaussian kernels for efficient normal estimation without volumetric gradient costs.
